findings.ownership: renderer — packages/flux-renderers-layout/src/wizard-step-helpers.ts computeCanGoTo L74 (furthestReached+1 always allowed) + wizard-step-nav.tsx L82-88 (onGoToStep skips commit)
findings.evidence: empty required field + click '2Review' nav -> {navs cur=step on Review, reviewVisible:true}, no error; control: Next button correctly blocked with inline error
findings.redE2eSketch: goto /#/lab/wizard -> stage host-wizard-step-validation -> with empty required input click nav nth(1) -> expect aria-current stays on Details (currently red: jumps to Review)
